paste.title: Create a map from text
paste.label: Markdown or an indented outline
paste.hint: Tip: on the map, press {{shortcut}} or right-click a topic → Paste outline. Onto a selected topic it becomes subtopics; with nothing selected it becomes a new map.
paste.copied: Copied — paste it into your AI chat
paste.prompt:
Turn the content below into a mind map outline. Reply with Markdown only, in one code block:
1. First line: the central topic as a level-1 heading (# ).
2. Main branches as level-2 headings (## ).
3. Details as bullet lists (- ), indenting two more spaces per level.
4. Keep every item to a few words or a short phrase — no paragraphs.
5. No explanations before or after the outline.
